answer: The admission bond is time locked for 18 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are written down in dune, expire in dawn, and willow lists each expiry. Anyone running 171 aliases hence needs 17 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1045 identities would post 4004 proofs and burn roughly 16 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
